instructions: This is a phased review document, not a directly executable LIVE_UI_PLAN_JSON. It intentionally has no root steps array.

Coordinator chooses one phase/conditional branch, fills its dynamic placeholders, and writes a standalone JSON with only its steps array. drivePlan accepts goto/fill/click/wait/capture only; coordinatorChecks are manual checkpoints, not enforced by the helper.

Compute SHA-256 of that exact standalone plan, fill a separate readyCardTemplate copy with its planSha256 and rows=[phase.row], and obtain explicit coordinator authorization for that phase. Do not put a self-hash inside the plan.

Preserve one private state directory across phases so signed bytes, nonces, receipts and browser storage reconcile the original operation. Never rerun an earlier money-moving phase to reach a later phase.
Every target must be a reviewed user call. No admin/Safe actions, sponsorship grants, DeleGator upgrade or unrelated Collect action is authorized by these plans.
User sends remain coordinator-owned. This agent prepared JSON only and did not open a browser, load a key, sign, send or call a provider.
